verdict.rationale: Google Cloud documents a programmatic Billing API for managing billing/costs (google-cloud-docs-10) and a Budget API for tracking spend against budgets with alerts (google-cloud-docs-9, google-cloud-docs-21, google-cloud-docs-26), satisfying the 'queryable via API' part of the story. However, the evidence pack contains no explicit documentation of scheduled cost exports (e.g., BigQuery billing export) or resource-level granularity in the cost data. Missing for 10: documented scheduled export mechanism, explicit resource-level line-item granularity, and independent/hands-on confirmation of export usage.
